employees_org_pan_uq.name: employees_org_pan_uq
employees_org_pan_uq.where: "employees"."deleted_at" is null and "employees"."pan_index" is not null

payroll_runs_maker_checker.name: payroll_runs_maker_checker
payroll_runs_maker_checker.value: "payroll_runs"."approved_by" is null or ("payroll_runs"."approved_by" <> "payroll_runs"."created_by" and "payroll_runs"."approved_by" is distinct from "payroll_runs"."submitted_by")

settlements_maker_checker.name: settlements_maker_checker
settlements_maker_checker.value: "settlements"."approved_by" is null or "settlements"."approved_by" is distinct from "settlements"."created_by"

attendance_times.name: attendance_times
attendance_times.value: "attendance_records"."check_out" is null or "attendance_records"."check_in" is null or "attendance_records"."check_out" >= "attendance_records"."check_in"
